d: Not too long ago, Lakshya Sen was facing questions about his consistency, his ability to close out matches and whether he could rediscover his best badminton. Now, the Indian shuttler has won back-to-back titles at the Hylo Open and Japan Masters. His comeback has been built on fewer unforced errors, better composure and some timely wins. After the disappointment of the Paris Olympics and a difficult spell on the circuit, Lakshya is back in the conversation. Rupha Ramani looks at what has changed for the Indian badminton star and why these two titles could mean so much.
